title: Image family pages use the real adjustment glyphs and the one color picker
notes: From ux-audit rescan 2026-08-23 ('Image family'). Pages: image, img-bg-remove, img-masking, img-grade-wt, img-retouch-wt, effects, paint. Key items: adjustment/effect glyphs to ic-curves/ic-levels/ic-blur/ic-shadow/ic-noise/ic-glow/ic-border/ic-saturation/ic-exposure; ic-mask for mask concepts; ic-compare for before/after on both retouch and masking; .rmtag scoping bug renders unstyled on img-bg-remove + img-masking (fix scope); inert span.en toggles to buttons with aria-pressed; color slots to .cpick-btn + shared .cpick (img-grade-wt stwheel, effects/paint rows, bg-remove .bgsw); paint editor stack belongs in .cpick per D7; delete legacy titlebar/toolbar/.cmdk; dedupe repeated Option-Command-L shortcut. Verify 200 + audit-sweep.
acceptance: Every adjustment/effect row wears its own glyph (curves, levels, blur, shadow, noise, glow, border, saturation, exposure, temperature, sharpen, vignette); ic-mask for mask concepts; ic-compare for before/after on retouch and masking
.rmtag renders styled in .masklist as well as .lrow (now the shared .rtag / .rtag.accent)
Effect enable switches are real buttons with aria-pressed, not inert spans
Every color slot is a .cpick-btn opening the one shared .cpick: img-grade-wt split tone, effects glow + fill, paint fill, img-bg-remove backdrop
paint.html's inline paint-editor stack (type switch, ramp, angle dial, selected stop) lives in the one .cpick per D7
Legacy titlebar/toolbar/.cmdk deleted from all seven pages
Library menu item no longer shares the panel dock's Option-Command-L
All pages HTTP 200 and audit-sweep.js clean

log.note: Shipped. Central: .cpick builds its own body and any .cpick-btn[data-cp-slot] re-points it (data-cp-color/-paint/-flat/-open); .efx .en is a <button> with the press in core.js and the reset in canvas.css; .rtag row tag in inspector.css; walkthrough data-activate syncs aria-pressed; .cpick-btn label stays one line. Pages: image, img-bg-remove, img-masking, img-grade-wt, img-retouch-wt, effects, paint. Library shortcut moved to Control-Command-L on all 15 pages that collided with the dock's Option-Command-L. Verified in Chrome, not by grep: 90/90 pages HTTP 200; audit-sweep.js over 89 pages reports zero findings (73 segs, 79 dock managers); no JS errors on 26 spot-checked pages; real interaction confirmed the backdrop picker repaints the cut-out layer, the split-tone slots share one popover, the glow slot hides the paint-type row while the fill slot shows it and a linear paint reaches the card, and paint.html opens on the brand gradient with a 3-stop ramp. Left out on purpose: the before/after wipe on img-retouch-wt stayed page artwork (prefixed rt-*) because no second page needs it yet. Filed effect-switches-are-real-buttons-on-the-pages-th for the inert span.en found outside this family.

All seven image-family pages conform: real adjustment/effect glyphs (curves, levels, exposure, saturation, temperature, sharpen, vignette, blur, shadow, noise, glow, border), ic-mask for mask concepts, ic-compare for before/after, effect switches are real buttons with aria-pressed, every color slot is a .cpick-btn on the ONE shared picker (bg-remove backdrop, grade split tone, effects glow + fill, paint fill), paint.html's inline paint-editor stack moved into that picker per D7, legacy titlebar/toolbar/.cmdk gone, Library shortcut moved off the dock's Option-Command-L. Central DS work: .cpick builds its own body, [data-cp-slot] triggers re-point it, .rtag row tag, .efx button reset + shared press. Verified in Chrome: 90/90 pages 200, audit-sweep clean over 89, no JS errors, live interaction on each new picker. Commit 7d8d966.
